title: Lemon Sherbet
changes_from_base: Lemon zest, lemon juice and cold whole milk replace the orange juice and cream; no whipping.
summary: A tangy, refreshing lemon sherbet made in the blender with zest-rubbed sugar, lemon juice and cold whole milk.

ingredients.item: light corn syrup or glucose syrup
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Zest sugar
steps.text: Pulse the sugar and lemon zest in the blender 8-10 times, until the sugar looks damp and pale yellow.

steps.title: Dissolve
steps.text: Add the cold lemon juice, corn syrup and salt and blend for 20 seconds.

steps.title: Milk
steps.text: With the blender on low, pour in the very cold milk and blend for 30 seconds; cold milk and constant blending stop it curdling.

steps.title: Churn and freeze
steps.text: Churn straight away for 20-25 min, then freeze for 2-3 h.

tips: Everything must be very cold so the milk does not curdle.
Use unwaxed lemons as you need the zest.
Serve with blueberries or a thin lemon biscuit.
storage: Keep covered with baking paper on the surface in the freezer for up to 1 week. Soften for 5-10 min before scooping.
